html:
{%- if letter_head and not no_letterhead -%}
{{ letter_head }}
{%- endif -%}
{{ doc.posting_date or doc.transaction_date or "05th February, 2026" }}
{{ doc.customer_name or doc.customer_id or "" }}

{{ doc.customer_city or doc.address or "Thimphu" }}

Sub: Part Payment received for one unit {{ doc.customer_report or "Corolla Hybrid" }}
{{ doc.salutation or "Sir/Madam" }},
We have received sum of test Nu {{ doc.table_yefo | sum(attribute='advances_paid') }} ({{ doc.amount_in_words or frappe.utils.money_in_words(doc.table_yefo | sum(attribute='advances_paid') or 0).replace("INR", "BTN") }}) Against Jr # {{ doc.mbob_jr or doc.custom_mbob_reference or "" }} (MBOB) and Jr # {{ doc.mpay_jr or doc.custom_mpay_reference or "" }} (MPAY) dated {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.payment_date or doc.posting_date) if (doc.payment_date or doc.posting_date) else "" }}, for booking of one unit {{ doc.customer_report or "Corolla Hybrid" }} .
Please treat this letter as money receipt for your reference.
Thanking You,
Yours sincerely,
(Authorized Signatory)
(Customer’s copy)
Money receipt generated on {{ frappe.utils.nowdate() }} | Retain for booking reference
{% if not no_letterhead and footer %}
{{ footer }}
{% endif %}
name: Acknowledge Letter
